subject: general
question: Which of the following is in the third trophic level of the food chain?
solution:
​Food chain: 

__
 
• A food chain shows the feeding relationship between different organisms in a particular environment and/or habitat.
 
• A food chain shows how energy is passed from the sun to producers, from producers to consumers, and from consumers to decomposes such as fungi.
 
• They also show how animals depend on other organisms for food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

Tropic level: 

__
 
• Based on the source of their nutrition or food, organisms occupy a specific place in the food chain that is known as their trophic level.
 
• Producers belong to the first trophic level, herbivores (primary consumer) to the second and carnivores (secondary consumer) to the third. 
 
• The important point to note is that the amount of energy decreases at successive trophic levels.
 
• Every food chain starts with producers at the base tropic level and tertiary consumers at the top of the tropic level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/149da41b2e58def7608e4afb88e8bd29b90d52c1d6f0d4542f251b74e5e38052.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 Tropic Level (from top to bottom)
 Description
 Example
 
 

 Tertiary Consumers
 
 __
 
• They feed on the secondary consumers.
 
 
 Tiger, vulture etc.
 
 

 Secondary consumers
 
 
 
• They can either be carnivores (feeding only on animals) or omnivores. 
 
• They feed on the primary consumers.
 
 
 Small birds, wolves, snakes, mouse etc.
 
 

 Primary Consumer
 
 
 

 
 
• They are also sometimes referred to as herbivores because they mainly feed on plants i.e. the producers.
 
• They can also be omnivores (feeding on both plants and animals).
 
 
 Cow, deer, grasshoppers, small insects etc.
 
 

 Primary producers
 
 
 
• They produce food on their own with the help of photosynthesis.
 
 
 Plants, grass, trees, algae, phytoplankton.
 
 

**Thus, secondary consumers are in the third trophic level of the food chain.**__
